preconditions: PlanEvidenceBundle-1.0 with finite ordered terrain profile
GSJ Seamless V2 mapped surface geology samples

decisionLogic.terrain: Use source-linked GSI DEM profile without lithology feedback
decisionLogic.mappedSurface: Render GSJ point legend only as a segmented line on the terrain; never extend mapped intervals vertically into subsurface polygons
decisionLogic.shallowGeometry: Generate six positive correlated synthetic-facies thickness fields independently of terrain and mapped-surface identity
decisionLogic.composition: Anchor an initial shared-contact stack below terrain, then pass it through the common stratigraphic event primitives for erosion and erosion-fill; extend basement to the frame bottom
decisionLogic.nonParallelism: Reject output when the event engine is absent or produces no truncation/pinch-out active-mask transition
decisionLogic.preOutputGate: Before file creation audit model separation, event connection, thickness/contact invariants, mapped-surface non-projection, and finite lithology-boundary arrays
decisionLogic.terrainIndependenceDiagnostic: Use a fixed-terrain multi-seed ensemble because ordinary Pearson p-values from a single pair of autocorrelated profiles are not a valid independence test
decisionLogic.legend: Exclude globally inactive event bodies from the visible lithology legend
decisionLogic.lithologyBoundaryLines: When enabled, draw each primary contact only over intervals where its overlying body remains active; terminate older contacts at the unconformity
decisionLogic.genericLens: Prohibited in the standard arbitrary-route output without scoped evidence for depositional setting, length, thickness and endpoint taper
decisionLogic.colorMetadataMismatch: Preserve original hex, use source RGB for display, record warning

uncertainty: Mapped surface transitions are sampling-bracketed; generated thickness is uncalibrated
exclusions: Terrain alone does not determine subsurface lithology
Mapped surface identity does not prove generated vertical persistence
No vertical mapped-unit walls or unfilled area below the synthetic basement are permitted
Synthetic erosion/fill geometry is a demonstration hypothesis, not regional evidence
No real-region authorization without borehole and structural evidence review
No design use or native DWG release
validationMethod: Synthetic fixtures plus an independent Shimane route live-data run
reopenCondition: Add borehole constraints, structural observations, calibrated thickness, or a new public-data provider
